about: A csv artifact's declared missing text through the file route (CSV-4, CSV-17, INPUT-10). With output.missing of '.', every missing value of every type is written as a bare dot, while a collected empty string is still two quote characters and a value keeps its CSV-5 text, or under output.decimals its CSV-7 fixed-point text. A str value equal to the dot fails the output with the column and the number of its rows that hold it, and nothing is published; the declaration on a Parquet output is not applicable; a text other than the dot is outside the schema's closed values; and a consumer may not link a producer that declares one, since its linked read would take the dot for a value. Each saved file is written by hand from CSV-3, CSV-4, CSV-5, CSV-7 and CSV-17 over the input rows: the empty fields of the input are missing (CSV-14), and 4.686 at two decimals is 4.69. No engine output supplied these values.
